english.note: This is the all-purpose choice before an adjective or verb for an explicitly stated or implied degree, with the result clause supplying the “that” meaning when needed.

examples.english: You arrived so early that I’m not ready yet.
examples.traditional: 你咁早就到喇，搞到我仲未準備好。
